name: 37642 · Church Hill, TN
findings: ZIP 37642 (Church Hill) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37642 (Church Hill) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
